THIS LOAN AGREEMENT ("the Agreement") is made this 1st  October 2021 between:
Parties
<LENDER> (UEN: <OR IC>), a company incorporated in Singapore, whose registered address is <ADDRESS> ("Lender"); and
<COMPANY NAME> (UEN: ), a company incorporated in Singapore, whose registered address is ("Borrower").(hereinafter collectively referred to as “Parties")
WHEREAS
(A)        The Lender has agreed to provide the Borrower with a loan of Singapore Dollars One Hundred Thousand [S$ 100,000] in the terms and subject to the conditions of this Agreement.
AGREED TERMS
1.        Loan Quantum, Term, and Interest
Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, the Lender hereby agrees to lend to the Borrower a loan in the sum of Singapore Dollars Three Hundred Thousand [S$ 300,000] (“the Loan”).
The term of the loan shall expire 3 month from the date of this Agreement (1st Jan 2022) (“the Repayment Date”).
Interest of Five per cent (5%) per month on the Loan (“Interest”) shall accrue by reference to successive interest periods of one-month each (“Interest Period”).
2.        Drawdown
The Loan shall be deemed to be drawn down by the Borrower on the date of this Agreement.
3.        Repayment of Loan
The Borrower shall repay the accrued interest being the sum of SGD Fifteen Thousand [S$ 15,000] on the first interest interest period on 22 May 2021.
The Borrower shall repay the Loan and the accrued interest being the sum of Singapore Dollars Three Hundred and Fifteen Thousand [S$ 315,000] full on the Repayment Date.

If the repayment of Interest and the Loan is not received by the Lender on or before the due date, the Lender shall charge compounding default interest of five per cent (5%) on all Outstanding Amounts, which shall for the avoidance of doubt include unpaid Loan Interest.
In connection with the foregoing, the Borrower shall issue to the Lender on the date of this Agreement post dated cheques for the repayments in favour of the Lender.
4.        Personal Guarantees

(a)        The Borrower further undertakes to obtain its shareholder to grant a personal guarantee (substantially in the form as attached hereto as Schedule 1) in favour of the Lender, in respect of its obligations to make full payment of the Outstanding Amount.
5.        Termination
Either Party may by written notice of not less than one (1) month to the other Party, terminate this Agreement at any time.
In the event of early termination of this Agreement, the Borrower shall repay the outstanding principal and interest accrued on a pro-rata basis.
6.        Illegality
(a)         The Lender may require the Borrower to repay the Outstanding Amount, or the Loan or the interest if:

any applicable law or regulation of Singapore is introduced or changed, orthere is any change in the way the Singapore's court or regulatory authority interprets or applies any law or regulation which;
complying with any direction, request or requirement (whether or not havingthe force of law) of any Singapore monetary agency, central bank, or governmental or regulatory authority; or
any judgment, order or direction of any court, tribunal or authority bindingon the Lender,
makes it unlawful for the Lender to make any Loan or allow any Loan and/interest to remain outstanding.
(b)         To require repayment under clause 6 (a), the Lender shall give notice to the Borrower at least 1 month's prior notice demanding repayment and giving the date for that repayment.
(c)         The Borrower shall then repay the Outstanding Amount, or the Loan or the interest as set out in the notice.
7.        Representations and Warranties
(a)        Each party represents, warrants and undertakes to the other Party that:
(i)        It has the power to enter into, exercise its rights and perform and comply with its obligations under this Agreement to which it is a party;
(ii)        This Agreement, when executed, constitutes legal, valid and binding and enforceable obligations;
(iii)        The execution and delivery of and the performance by such Party of its obligations under this Agreement do not and will not:
Result in a breach of constitutional documents of such Party or any Agreement or legal instrument to which such Party is a party; or
Result in a breach of any applicable law, regulation, order, judgment or decree of any court, governmental agency or regulatory body to which such Party is a party or by which such Party is bound;

Constitute an act or deed that may be deemed or be construed in any way whatsoever as an act/acts of money laundering or financing of terrorism under any applicable laws and regulations in Singapore or elsewhere.
(iv)        It shall obtain and apply for and procure all applicable approvals, permits, licences for this transaction, if so applicable.
8.        Good Faith
Each party hereto shall at all times act honestly and in good faith and use reasonable diligence in the exercise of its or his rights and in the discharge of its obligations under this Agreement.
9.        Confidential Information

All communications by the Lender to the Borrower and all information and other material supplied to or received by the Borrower from the Lender which is either marked "confidential" or is by its nature intended to be exclusively for the knowledge of the Borrower alone and any information concerning the business transactions or the financial arrangements of the Lender or of any person with whom the Lender is in a confidential relationship with regard to the matter in question coming to the knowledge of the Borrower shall be kept confidential by the Borrower unless or until the Borrower can demonstrate that it is or part of it is, in the public domain, whereupon, to the extent that it is public, this obligation shall cease.
The Borrower shall procure the observance of the above-mentioned restrictions and shall take all reasonable steps to minimise the risk of disclosure of confidential information.

The obligations contained in this Clause shall endure, even after the termination of this Agreement, without limit in point of time except and until any confidential information enters the public domain as set out above.
10.        Severance

If any provision (or part of a provision) of this Agreement is or becomes invalid, illegal or unenforceable, it shall be deemed modified to the minimum extent necessary to make it valid, legal and enforceable. If such modification is not possible, the relevant provision (or part of a provision) shall be deemed deleted. Any modification to or deletion of a provision (or part of a provision) under this clause shall not affect the legality, validity and enforceability of the rest of the Agreement.
11.        Partial Invalidity

The illegality, invalidity or unenforceability of any provision of this Agreement under the law of any jurisdiction shall not affect its legality, validity or enforceability under the law of any other jurisdiction nor the legality, validity or enforceability of any other provision.

Each Party shall, in any such event, execute such additional documents as the other Parties may reasonably request in order to give valid, legal and enforceable effect to any provision which is determined to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable.

If any provision shall be void, illegal or unenforceable but would be valid and enforceable if read down, then that provision shall be read down to the extent necessary to render the provision valid and enforceable.
12.        Third party rights

Except as expressly provided elsewhere in this Agreement, a person who is not a party to this Agreement has no right under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act (Chapter 53B) to enforce or enjoy the benefit of any term of this Agreement. This does not affect any right or remedy of a third party which exists, or is available, apart from that Act.
13.        Waivers

Waiver of any breach of this Agreement or of any right, power, authority, discretion or remedy arising upon a breach of or default under this Agreement, must be in writing and signed by the Party granting the waiver.
14.        Governing law and jurisdiction

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Singapore. In relation to any legal action or proceedings arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, the parties irrevocably submit to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Singapore.

THIS DEED OF GUARANTEE & INDEMNITY ("GUARANTEE") is entered into on the day of June 2020 between:
<BORROWER> (NRIC No.: ), a Singapore Citizen residing at ADDRESS (“Borrower”);(the "Guarantor");

[BENEFICIARY COMPANY] (UEN: [COMPANY REGISTRATION NUMBER]), a company incorporated in Singapore, whose registered address is [REGISTERED ADDRESS] ("Beneficiary");(Hereinafter collectively referred to as "Parties").
WHEREAS:

At the request of the Guarantor the beneficiary entered into a Loan Agreement on 1st October 2021 with <COMPANY NAME> (UEN: ), a company incorporated in Singapore, whose registered office at <OFFICE ADDRESS> (“the Company”).
Under the Loan Agreement. the Company agreed to repay the Loan of Singapore Dollars Three Hundred Thousand [S$ 100,000] and its accrued interest ("Outstanding Amount") to the Beneficiary.

The Guarantor hereby further guarantees to the Beneficiary in his personal capacity, that in the event of any failure to pay the Outstanding Amount under the Loan Agreement, he shall pay the Outstanding Amount to the Beneficiary.
AGREED TERMS:

In consideration of the Beneficiary agreeing at the Guarantor' request to loan working capital to the Company, the Guarantor guarantee to the Beneficiary as principal obligor in his personal capacity, whenever the Company does not or are unable to pay any part of the Outstanding Amount when due under the Loan Agreement, that he pay on demand the Outstanding Amount or such part thereof.

For the avoidance of doubt, in the event of the Company's default under the Loan Agreement to make payment of the Outstanding Amount or such part thereof when due, the Beneficiary shall not be required to demand or take any action against the Guarantor thereunder and may make demand pursuant to this Guarantee to pay the Outstanding Amount or such part thereof.

The Guarantor as principal obligor in his personal capacity, and as a separate and independent obligation and liability from his obligations and liabilities under Clause 1, agree to indemnify and keep indemnified the Beneficiary in full and on demand from and against all and any losses, costs, claims, liabilities, damages, demands and expenses suffered or incurred by the Beneficiary arising out of, or in connection with, the Outstanding Amount not being recoverable for any reason or any failure of the Guarantor to perform or discharge any of his obligations or liabilities in respect of the Outstanding Amount under the Loan Agreement.

4.        This Guarantee is and shall at all times be a continuing security and shall cover the ultimate balance from time to time owing to the Beneficiary by the Guarantor under the Loan Agreement in respect of the Outstanding Amount.
5.        The liability of the Guarantor under this Guarantee shall not be reduced, discharged or otherwise adversely affected by:
any intermediate payment, settlement of account or discharge in whole or in part of the Outstanding Amount;

any variation, extension, discharge, compromise, dealing with, exchange or renewal of any right or remedy which the Beneficiary may now or after the date of this Guarantee have from or against the Guarantor or any other person in connection with the Outstanding Amount;
any act or omission by the Beneficiary or any other person in enforcing any indemnity or guarantee from or against the Guarantor or any other person;
any grant of time, indulgence, waiver or concession to the Guarantor or any other person;

any insolvency, bankruptcy, liquidation, administration, winding up, incapacity, limitation, disability, the discharge by operation of law, or any change in the constitution, name or style of the Company, the Beneficiary or any other person; or
any other act or omission except an express written release by deed of the Guarantor by the Beneficiary.
6.        The Guarantor represents and warrants that:

The execution, delivery, and performance of his obligations in, and transactions contemplated by, this Guarantee does not and will not contravene any agreement or instrument binding on the Guarantor or his Assets, or any applicable law or regulation; and
His obligations under this Guarantee are legal, valid, binding and enforceable.

7.        Any release, discharge or settlement between the Guarantor and the Beneficiary in relation to this Guarantee shall be conditional on no right, disposition or payment to the Beneficiary by the Guarantor or any other person in respect of the Outstanding Amount being avoided, set aside or ordered to be refunded under any enactment or law relating to breach of duty by any person, bankruptcy, liquidation, administration, protection from creditors generally or insolvency or for any other reason. If any right, disposition or payment is avoided, set aside or ordered to be refunded, the Beneficiary shall be entitled subsequently to enforce this Guarantee against the Guarantor as if such release, discharge or settlement had not occurred and any such right, disposition or payment had not been given or made.
8.         All sums payable by the Guarantor under this Guarantee shall be paid in full to the Beneficiary without any set-off, deduction, condition or counterclaim whatsoever.

The Guarantor shall not assign any of his rights or transfer any of his obligations under this Guarantee or enter into any transaction which would result in any of those rights or obligations passing to another person.

This Guarantee shall be binding on the successors and permitted assigns of the Parties. For the avoidance of doubt, in the event of the Guarantor's incapacitation or demise, the Beneficiary shall be entitled to demand for full payment of the Outstanding Amount from the Guarantor's nominated personal representative. The Guarantor further undertakes to ensure that his nominated personal representative is duly authorized and instructed to disburse the necessary monies from his Assets or estate in the event of his incapacitation or demise (whichever applicable) to make full payment of the Outstanding Amount to the Beneficiary.
No amendment of this Guarantee shall be effective unless it is in writing and signed by, or on behalf of, each Party (or its authorized representative).

12.        A waiver of any right or remedy under this Guarantee or by law, or any consent given under this Guarantee, is only effective if given in writing and signed by the waiving or consenting Party and shall not be deemed a waiver of any other breach or default. It only applies in the circumstances for which it is given and shall not prevent the Party giving it from subsequently relying on the relevant provision.

13.        A failure or delay by a Party to exercise any right or remedy provided under this Guarantee or by law shall not constitute a waiver of that or any other right or remedy, prevent or restrict any further exercise of that or any other right or remedy. No single or partial exercise of any right or remedy provided under this Guarantee or by law shall prevent or restrict the further exercise of that or any other right or remedy.
The rights and remedies provided under this Guarantee are cumulative and are in addition to, and not exclusive of, any rights and remedies provided by law.

If any provision (or part of a provision) of this Guarantee is or becomes invalid, illegal or unenforceable, it shall be deemed modified to the minimum extent necessary to make it valid, legal and enforceable. If such modification is not possible, the relevant provision (or part of a provision) shall be deemed deleted. Any modification to or deletion of a provision (or part of a provision) under this clause shall not affect the legality, validity and enforceability of the rest of this Guarantee.
This Guarantee may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which when executed shall constitute a duplicate original, but all the counterparts shall together constitute one deed.

This Guarantee and any dispute or claim (including non-contractual disputes or claims) arising out of or in connection with it or its subject matter or formation shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of Singapore.

Each Party irrevocably agrees that, subject as provided below, the courts of Singapore shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute or claim (including non-contractual disputes or claims) arising out of or in connection with this Guarantee or its subject matter or formation. Nothing in this Clause shall limit the right of the Beneficiary to take proceedings against the Guarantor in any other court of competent jurisdiction, nor shall the taking of proceedings in any one or more jurisdictions preclude the taking of proceedings in any other jurisdictions, whether concurrently or not, to the extent permitted by the law of such other jurisdiction.
IN WITNESS of which this Guarantee has been executed as a deed and is delivered and takes effect on the date stated at the beginning of it.

Memorandum of Understanding

Whereas ___., Ltd ("Party A") and [*] ("Party B", together with Party A, the "Parties") intend to achieve the shared goals through this strategic cooperation that aims to jointly develop business ( the "Cooperation"). In order to ensure productive cooperation between the Parties, this memorandum is executed to specify the scope of the Cooperation, responsibilities and rights of the Parties during the Cooperation.

Goals of the CooperationThe Parties agreed that the goals of this Cooperation are a) to combine the resources of the Parties to promote the commercial cooperation; b) to increase the number of customers and achieve performance growth.
Scope of the CooperationThe Parties agreed that this Cooperation will be carried out in the fields of a) brand promotion; b) activity organizations; and c) technical services.
Method of the CooperationThe Parties agreed that this Cooperation will be carried out in the form of a) free of charge resource sharing, and b) paid business services.
Party A’s Rights and ObligationsThe Parties agree that the main rights and obligations of Party A in this Cooperation are as follows:
Provide more display opportunities
Connect with more commercial ecosystems；
Ensure that the platform operates in compliance with relevant laws and regulations；and
Party A has the right of access to Party B’s account status on Party A’s platform,  including but not limited to account operation, number and activity of fans, etc.
Party B’s Rights and ObligationsThe Parties agree that the main rights and obligations of Party B in this cooperation are as follows:
Comply with relevant rules and regulations regarding platform usage;
Actively maintain the reputation of the platform;
Promote the development of the platform; and

Party B shall ensure that its commercial activities are within the scope of the Cooperation and do not involve, including but not limited to, politically sensitive information, pornographic information, and other illegal or activities in violation of any governmental rules or regulations.

ConfidentialityThe Parties agreed that they should keep the existence of this Cooperation and other relevant commercial information obtained during this Cooperation confidential, and shall not disclose to any third party without prior written consent of the other party.
DurationThis memorandum shall take effect from the date of execution and shall be valid for one year. The Parties agree to work together to achieve the goals of the Cooperation within such duration.

TerminationThis memorandum of understanding shall be terminated by mutual agreement between the Parties. After the termination of this memorandum, the Parties shall continue to perform the respective obligations agreed until completion or termination of such obligation. The Confidentiality clause in Article 6 and Dispute Resolution clause in Article 9 of this memorandum shall remain effective even after the termination of this memorandum.

Dispute ResolutionThe Parties agree that any disagreement or disputes arising from this Cooperation should be resolved through friendly communication between the Parties. If such communication fails, any relevant lawsuit should be filed at a Singapore courthouse.

Force of BindingThis memorandum is a letter of intent for commercial cooperation between the Parties. It is not legally binding except for the Confidentiality clause in Article 6 and the Dispute Resolution clause in Article 9. The Parties will stipulate the rights and responsibilities of each party in details in any subsequent cooperation agreement. This memorandum is made in two copies, each party holds one copy with the same legal effect

DEED OF INDEMNITY
THIS DEED is dated 23 September 2022.
BETWEEN:
[NEW COMPANY], a company incorporated in the Republic of Singapore, with its registered office at [NEW ADDRESS] (the“Company”);And
[NOMINEE], NRIC No.:[NOMINEE NRIC], residing at [NOMINEE ADDRESS] (the “Nominee Director”), (the Company and the Nominee Director each a “Party” and collectively the “Parties”).
BACKGROUND
The Company requires the Director Services and wishes to appoint the Nominee Director to provide them.
The Nominee Director is willing to provide the Director Services to the Company.
The Company and the Nominee Director intend to give effect to Recitals A and B above, in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Deed.
It is agreed that:
DEFINITIONSIn this Deed, unless the context otherwise requires, the following definitions apply:
“Act” means the Singapore Companies Act (Cap. 50, 2006 Rev Ed);

“Applicable Law” means legislation, regulations, statutes, by-laws, Approvals and/or other laws and any other instrument or direction from officials having the force of law as may be issued and in force from time to time (and any amendment or subordinate provisions thereto) relating to or connected with the activities contemplated under this Deed, wherever so located and/or performed;

“Approvals” means any licences, permits, consents, approvals and authorisations (statutory, regulatory or otherwise) that a Party may require (whether to comply with Applicable Law or otherwise) to perform its obligations under this Deed;

“Board” means the board of Directors of the Company, acting together as a board of directors; “Business Day” means a day other than a weekend, official public holiday or a day upon which banks are otherwise generally closed for business in Singapore;

“Claim” means any allegation, debt, judgement, cause of action, action, claim, proceeding, suit or demand of any nature howsoever arising and whether present or future, fixed or unascertained, actual or contingent whether at law, in equity, under statute or otherwise asserted by any Person at any time;
“Director” has the meaning given to that term in section 4(1) of the Act;
“Director Services” means the Nominee Director’s acting as a Director of the Company;
“Employee” shall mean a person employed for wages or salary as defined in the relevant legislation of Singapore;
“Loss” means any loss, damage, cost, expense, penalty expenses or equivalent of whatever nature whatsoever;
“Nominee Director Fees” means the fees payable to the Nominee Director for providing the Director Services in accordance with this Deed;

“Person” means any natural person, corporate or unincorporated body (whether or not having separate legal personality), individual, corporation, partnership, limited liability company or similar entity; and
“Term” means the period during which the Nominee Director provides Director Services to the Company.
INTERPRETATIONIn this Deed (except where the context otherwise requires):
Words in the singular include the plural and vice versa, and words importing any gender include every gender;
References to clauses are to clauses of this Deed;
the clause headings are included for ease of reference only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Deed;

A reference to a statute or statutory provision includes a reference to such statute or statutory provision as from time to time amended, re-enacted or replaced (whether before or after the date of this Deed); and
A reference to the Nominee Director also includes where is acting on behalf of or with the knowledge of the Nominee Director.
ACKNOWLEDGMENTSThe Company acknowledges and agrees that:

the intention of this Deed is for the Company to fully and completely indemnify and hold the Nominee Director harmless from any and all liability arising out of the provision of the Director Services; and
but for the indemnities provided in this Deed, the Nominee Director would not be willing to provide the Director Services to the Company and would not have entered into this Deed.
INDEMNITY
Subject to the Act and Clause 4.2, the Company shall defend, indemnify and keep the Nominee Director and held harmless from and against any and all Claims or Losses:
arising in connection with anything done or omitted to be done by the Nominee Director, in their capacity as either an Employee or in the execution of their duties as a Director of the Company;

arising as a result of any act or omission of the Company or its affiliates, which are made against the Nominee Director, or for which they become liable for, in their capacity as a Director or Employee of the Company; and

arising out of any liability to any Person or Claim by such a Person other than the Company for any act or omission of the Nominee Director taken in his or her capacity as a Director or Employee of the Company; and

incurred by the Nominee Director in defending or settling any Claim or process relating to and/or in connection with the Company’s failure to engage another local resident Director, after notice has been provided under Clause 5.7.
The Nominee Director acknowledges and agrees that the indemnities provided under Clause 4.1, shall not extend to:
any liability incurred by the Nominee Director which arises solely and directly from the Nominee Director’s proven fraud, willful misconduct or negligence; and
any cost or expense in respect of which the Company is prohibited by Applicable Law from indemnifying the Nominee Director.
REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIESThe Company warrants and represents to the Nominee Director that it shall procure throughout the Term that:
The Nominee Director is provided with a list of Persons authorised to give instructions to the Nominee Director;
To promptly update and inform the Nominee Director of any changes to the list provided under Clause 5.1;
It shall keep proper accounts and file all tax returns, papers and other documents as required by Applicable Law and to pay all fees and taxes which the Company is required to pay;

The name and copies of documents of the Nominee Director and any information contained therein shall not be used or quoted in any document or transaction without the Nominee Director’s prior written consent (this includes without limitation the opening of any bank accounts or other accounts by the Company);
All acts required by the Director in performing its duties as a Director of the Company, shall comply with Applicable Laws binding upon the Company and/or the Nominee Director;
All statements and documents which the Company (or its authorised Persons) requests that the Nominee Director sign shall be true and accurate; and
It shall immediately appoint another Person eligible to replace the Nominee Director, upon receiving notice from the Nominee Director to do so;
Any documentation requested by the Nominee Director shall be provided by the Company within 7 days in accordance with the request (including but not limited to any supporting documents).

COMPANY TO MEET COSTSWithout prejudice to any other provision of this Deed, where, in the reasonable opinion of the Board, it appears that the Nominee Director is entitled to the indemnity under this Deed, the Company will:
Pay, and bear all associated costs of, any legislative or government required payment including but not limited to Central Provident Fund contributions;
Meet any costs or expenses incurred by the Nominee Director in defending or settling the related proceedings; and
Shall meet such costs or expenses, as they are incurred.
RENEWAL
Pursuant to the Terms of Business, the engagement of the Nominee Director shall continue unless otherwise notified in writing with at least 30 days’ notice.

Without prejudice to any terms in this Deed, the Nominee Director, at his/her sole discretion, shall be entitled to apply to the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (“ACRA”) on behalf of the Company to strike the Company’s name off the register or to commence any such action to the same effect in the following event:-
An eligible person is not appointed to replace the Nominee Director following the notice of the Nominee Director to do so and in any event within 30 days’ in breach of clause 5.1.7;
The Company is in material breach of any of its warranties and representations;

The Company’s appointed accounting and/or tax service provider (if not appointed with the approval of ) fails to provide satisfactory accounts, papers, and documents in the opinion of the Nominee Director; or
The Company fails to pay the Nominee Director Fees following 7 days of notice of default by.
INSURANCESubject always to the Act and the terms of the constitution of the Company, the Company must:

At all times hold and maintain reasonable insurance cover or other financial means or other financial means against its liability under Clauses 4, 5, 6 and 8, of a scope and type and in the amount as the Board, acting reasonably, approves;
Effect insurance or other financial means for the Nominee Director in respect of costs incurred:
By him or her in defending or settling any Claim or proceeding relating to that liability; and

By him or her in defending any criminal proceedings that have been brought in relation to any act or omission undertaken in his or her capacity as a Director or Employee and in which he or she is acquitted, of such scope and type as the Board, acting reasonably, approves; and
Of such scope and type as the Board, acting reasonably, approves; and
Ensure that insurance effected under Clauses 8.1 and 8.2 remains in effect and applies, or is replaced by insurance which remains in effect and applies, in relation to Claims brought:
During the period of one year after the Nominee Director ceases to be a Director or Employee of the Company; or
Such other longer periods as the Board, acting reasonably, determines.
FEES

The Beneficial Owner shall pay the Nominee SGD 2,000 within 3 days of signing this document. Payment shall be made to:Account Name:[ACCOUNT HOLDER’S NAME]Account Number:[ACCOUNT NUMBER]Bank/Institution:[BANK NAME]SWIFT Code:[SWIFT CODE]Bank Address:[BANK ADDRESS]
The Nominee agrees to be the nominee of the Company for the shorter period of:
12 months from the date of the incorporation of the Company

Subject to Clause 8.1, the Nominee Director accepts that full payment of the Nominee Director Fee shall have been made by the Company once has collected from the Company the fee for facilitating the provision of the Director Services.

If for whatever reason the Company fails to pay the fees which it is due in connection with facilitating access to the Nominee Director and the Director Services, the Company shall pay the Nominee Director the Nominee Director Fees:
directly to the nominated account details of the Nominee Director; and
within 7 days of receiving notice to do so.

In the event that the Nominee Director Fees remain unpaid 7 days after receipt of notice from , the Nominee Director shall be entitled to apply, to the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) on behalf of the Company to strike the Company’s name off the register and or to commence any such action to the same effect.
THIRD PARTY BENEFICIARY
Except as expressly provided herein, this Deed does not create any rights that are enforceable under Applicable Law by any Person who is not a Party to this Deed.
The Company expressly acknowledges and agrees that the indemnities given to the Nominee Director in this Deed are also for the benefit of and shall also be enforceable by the Nominee Director.
For the avoidance of any doubt, Clauses 10.1 and 10.2 are both for the benefit of and shall be enforceable by the Nominee Director.
CONDUCT OF PROCEEDINGS
The indemnified Party under this Deed shall deliver to the indemnifying Party notice of the relevant Claim as soon as is reasonably practicable after becoming aware of the relevant Claim.

The indemnifying Party shall, at its option, cost and expense, have conduct of all negotiations and proceedings (including the right to appoint legal counsel of its choice) regarding the relevant Claim.
The indemnifying Party undertakes to conduct negotiations and proceedings diligently and in so doing shall not adversely affect the indemnified Party’s reputation or goodwill.
Notwithstanding Clause 11.2, the indemnified Party shall provide such assistance as may be reasonably required by the indemnifying Party in respect of the relevant Claim.
The indemnified Party may, at its cost and expense, appoint its own legal counsel in connection with the relevant Claim, where it deems it necessary in its sole and absolute discretion.

No Party shall make any admission on behalf of the other Party regarding a relevant Claim which is reasonably likely to be prejudicial to the defence of such proceedings without the other Party’s prior written consent.
Subject to Clause 11.2, no Party shall compromise or settle such proceedings in relation to a relevant Claim without the prior written consent of the other Party.

The Parties acknowledge and agree that for the purposes of this Clause 11, references to an "indemnified Party" shall be understood to include Nominee Director, where is making an indemnity Claim under this Deed.
GENERAL
This Deed shall be binding on and shall ensure for the benefit of the successors of the Parties to this Deed.

No Party shall assign, transfer, mortgage, charge, subcontract, declare a trust over or deal in any other manner with any or all of its rights and obligations under this Deed (or any other document referred to in it), except as expressly provided herein.
12.3 Any notice or other communication to be given under this Deed shall be:
In writing and in English;

Shall be delivered by hand to the Parties' respective addresses as set out in this Deed, or as otherwise notified by the relevant Party from time to time, in accordance with the provisions of this Clause 12.3; and
A copy of the notice or other communication shall be sent to the email address as provided by the relevant Party from time to time.
A notice or other communication given under this Deed shall be deemed to have been received upon delivery to the address referred to in Clause 12.3.

This Deed may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which when executed shall constitute a duplicate original, but all the counterparts shall together constitute one and the same instrument. Transmission of an executed counterpart of this agreement (but for the avoidance of doubt not just a signature page) by email (in PDF, JPEG or other agreed format) shall take effect as the transmission of an executed "wet-ink" counterpart of this agreement.

Each party agrees that this Deed must be executed by electronic signature (whatever form the electronic signature takes) and that this method of signature is as conclusive of our intention to be bound as if signed by each party's manuscript signature.

This Deed is drawn up in the English language and the English language version of this Deed shall always prevail over any translation. This Deed shall be construed, interpreted and administered in English.
No variation to this Deed shall be effective unless in writing and signed by, or on behalf of, each Party.
For the avoidance of doubt, this Deed and the rights and obligations of the parties shall continue after the Term ends.
DISPUTE RESOLUTION

This Deed and any dispute or claim arising out of, or in connection with, it (including non contractual disputes or claims) is governed by and shall be construed in accordance with the laws of Singapore.
